dl.nojs_banner_text: Direct download links and live release metadata load when JavaScript is enabled. Docker and Podman commands further down work as shown. Use the releases link in the next section for versioned installers and wheels.

macos.friendly: Download the DMG, open it, and drag MeshChatX into Applications.

linux.arch_note: AppImage and DEB: AMD64 / ARM64, RPM: AMD64, Alpine APK: x64
linux.appimage_intro: A portable build with no package manager required. Download the architecture you need.
linux.no_appimage: No AppImage assets in latest release.
linux.deb_intro: Debian and Ubuntu packages for both AMD64 and ARM64.
linux.no_deb: No Debian packages in latest release.
linux.rpm_intro: An RPM package for 64-bit x86 systems.
linux.no_rpm: No RPM package in latest release.
linux.alpine_intro: apk-tools package for Alpine Linux on x86_64. This is not the Android APK.
linux.no_alpine: No Alpine package in latest release.
linux.flatpak_intro: Single-file bundle for systems with Flatpak installed.
linux.no_flatpak: No Flatpak bundle in latest release.
linux.arch_intro_before: Build and install manually using our PKGBUILD. This method handles dependencies and integrates with
linux.source_intro: If you want to run MeshChatX from the source code locally:
linux.friendly: Most people want the AppImage. Download it, make it executable, and run it.

windows.no_win: No Windows assets in latest release.
windows.friendly: Download the installer, run it, and open MeshChatX from the Start menu. Use portable if you prefer no install.

containers.registries_note: Same image from either registry. Use MESHCHAT_IMAGE in Compose to pick GHCR.
containers.friendly: Copy the Compose file if you run Docker or Podman day to day. Pull commands are under more options.

python.intro: Install from PyPI (includes the built frontend). Direct wheel URLs from GitHub releases appear below when available.
python.wheel_intro: Pin the exact wheel file for this release from GitHub.
python.uvx_hint: Run the meshchatx entry point from the package without a persistent install (uv tool run).
python.friendly: Install from PyPI with pip. That is enough for most people.

android.intro: A standalone Android APK is not yet available.
android.friendly: Android APK for the app, or Termux for a headless node.

umbrel.intro: Install MeshChatX on your Umbrel home server from the Umbrel App Store.

dl.pick_lead: Tap the system you use. We show the recommended download first.

flatpak.friendly: Install the single-file Flatpak bundle on any Linux distro with Flatpak.
flatpak.no_bundle: No Flatpak bundle in this release.
